questions.stem: A patient present with a history of repeated thoughts that their hands are unclean and repetitive handwashing. The treating psychiatrist makes a diagnosis of OCD. Which of the following statements about obsessions are true? Obsessions are disorders of possession of thought. Obsessions are ego-syntonic. Patients try to resist obsessions. Obsessions can be in the form of images.
